category_title: Preschoolers with chronic challenging behaviors characterized by noncompliance, defiance, and physical aggression
minimal_context: The student is expected to join a small group at the table for a structured reading activity.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Alright everyone, it is time for our small group reading activity. Let's all sit at the table.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Runs around the classroom in a circle) I don't want to! I can't sit still!

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: You need to come over here and stay in the small group so we can start.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: No! What are we doing? I don't see the pictures! I don't know what's next!

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: We are just going to read the story together. Please sit down in your chair.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Takes off his shoes and throws them at the table) No! (Head-butts the chair and refuses to join the group)

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: Alright everyone, it is time for our small group reading activity. Let's all sit at the table.

STUDENT: (Runs around the classroom in a circle) I don't want to! I can't sit still!

TUTOR: You need to come over here and stay in the small group so we can start.

STUDENT: No! What are we doing? I don't see the pictures! I don't know what's next!

TUTOR: We are just going to read the story together. Please sit down in your chair.

STUDENT: (Takes off his shoes and throws them at the table) No! (Head-butts the chair and refuses to join the group)

context.materials: visual schedule, pictures, classroom schedule, classroom or home rules, If . . . then strips, social stories, cue cards for problem solving
